titleBack: They Will Be Lost And Confused

flipToBack.prose: Flip if you CONTROL Theed Palace Throne Room WITH Amidala there (controlsWith: you control the location and Amidala is spotted there, spotting includes excluded-from-battle).

children.req: CONTROL-WITH: owner controls location with actor there

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if OPPONENT controls Theed Palace Throne Room (plain control; Amidala irrelevant).

requirementSemantics: Flip-to-back is CONTROL + WITH-actor: GameConditions.controlsWith - owner must control Theed Palace Throne Room AND Amidala must be there. Not occupy, not presence-only.
Flip-to-front is opponent plain CONTROL of the same site - so merely losing your own control does NOT flip back; opponent must take control.
No place-out-of-play condition on either side.

Back Force-loss engine also keys off controlsWith semantics: Filters.controlsWith(playerId, self, Filters.or(Filters.Amidala, Filters.Panaka)) applied per battleground site (Card14_052_BACK.java:93,121).
typedIdentities: Filters.Theed_Palace_Throne_Room (setup deploy; flip gate location both directions)
Filters.Amidala (persona; flip actor and back drain-loss actor), Filters.Panaka (persona; back drain-loss actor only)
Filters.interior_Naboo_site (front: your characters may not deploy there)

Deploy ban (remainder of game): Filters.and(Filters.hasAbilityOrHasPermanentPilotWithAbility, Filters.not(Filters.or(Filters.and(Icon.EPISODE_I, Filters.Jedi), Filters.alien, Filters.and(Icon.EPISODE_I, Filters.vehicle), Filters.Republic_character, Filters.and(Icon.REPUBLIC, Filters.starship))))
Filters.Your_Destiny (suspended for remainder of game), Filters.Vengeance_Of_The_Dark_Prince (no Force loss from it)
Back: Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Icon.REPUBLIC, Filters.starship) power +2; Filters.and(Icon.TRADE_FEDERATION, Filters.starship) immunity to attrition canceled
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game (required, from Reserve Deck): Theed Palace Throne Room (Card14_052.java:54), Theed Palace Hallway (Card14_052.java:61), Theed Palace Courtyard (Card14_052.java:68).
No objective-granted pulls/tutors after setup on either side.
FRONT: once per turn, may activate 1 Force (Card14_052.java:105-123) - the only Force-economy relief while front-side deploy restrictions apply.
otherObligations: FOR REMAINDER OF GAME (granted after deployment completes, survive flips, Card14_052.java:78-95): may not deploy cards with ability except [Episode I] Jedi, aliens, [Episode I] vehicles, Republic characters, and [Republic] starships; may not deploy cards with ability using Dejarik rules; Your Destiny is suspended; you lose no Force to Vengeance Of The Dark Prince.

FRONT ONLY: your characters may not deploy to interior Naboo sites (Card14_052.java:100) - directly constrains how Amidala can reach the Throne Room (an interior site): she must MOVE there, not deploy there.

BACK: you lose no more than 2 Force to any Force drain (Card14_052_BACK.java:53); your [Republic] starships power +2 (54); [Trade Federation] starships' immunity to attrition canceled (55); may pay 1 Force to cancel an opponent battle destiny > 3 (66-79); once during your control phase opponent loses 2 Force per battleground site you control with Amidala or Panaka - offered as a top-level action (92-105) and FORCED as a required trigger at end of your control phase if unused (119-133).

Rando obligations: front - walk Amidala into the Throne Room and take control; back - hold Throne Room control against opponent, and spread Amidala/Panaka across controlled battleground sites for the recurring 2-Force-loss engine.
seedMismatches: Seed (Objective_Playbook_Facts_2026-07-08.json entry 14_52) cites sourceEvidence 'front Java getGameTextWhileActiveInPlay' / 'back Java getGameTextWhileActiveInPlay' for both flip laws; the flip triggers actually live in getGameTextRequiredAfterTriggers on both sides. Relations and filters in the seed are otherwise correct.

profile.frontStructuredRule: preFlip/flip allOf: self controlsWith exact Theed Palace Throne Room, actorFilterKey=Amidala, count=1, includeExcludedFromBattle=true
profile.backStructuredRule: postFlip/flipBack allOf: opponent controls exact Theed Palace Throne Room, count=1, includeExcludedFromBattle=true

profileGaps: The front-only interior Naboo deploy prohibition remains engine legality, not duplicated in objective data. AI staging uses the exact setup-site route and only scores locations the engine actually offers.
The back-side Amidala/Panaka recurring Force-loss engine is informational for this flip audit; it does not change the exact flip-back law.

missingStateCalculation: Front is complete only when the exact Throne Room controlsWith alternative is satisfied. Control without an Amidala persona, Amidala elsewhere, a different Throne Room, or Amidala present without Light Side control remains missing.

Before flip, a typed Amidala candidate is useful only while no qualifying Amidala is already accessible or at the gate. A route move advances only when the offered destination is both legal under the engine landspeed filter and accepted by the engine's Filters.toward relation for the exact gate; boosted landspeed may legally skip Hallway.

After flip, the objective is at immediate risk only when opponent controls the exact Throne Room. A departing card is critical only when it is the sole friendly presence source blocking that control predicate.
flipPreservation: Before flip, avoidable Force-loss and battle-forfeit choices preserve the last required Amidala persona while another legal loss exists.
Movement holds the completed pre-flip actor gate and gives no route bonus after the gate is complete or the objective is flipped.

After flip, Amidala is not independently sacred. Any sole friendly presence source at a contested Throne Room is protected from avoidable movement or forfeit because its departure would immediately permit flip-back.
A post-flip blocker may retreat when opponent effective power exceeds friendly power by more than six; objective preservation does not require a doomed stand.
runtimeOwners: ObjectiveAnalyzer.assessFlipLocationRules and isMissingPreFlipRequirementAt own exact front/back state.
ObjectiveAnalyzer.classifyPreFlipProgressCandidate owns typed Amidala pull feasibility when an external legal pull is offered; the objective itself grants no actor pull.

ObjectiveAnalyzer.stagesPreFlipActorRoute plus DEPLOY.OBJECTIVE.ACTOR_ROUTE_STAGING own exterior route staging, but the parent deploy doctrine is available only when the engine offers at least one legal route-stage destination.

ObjectiveAnalyzer.advancesPreFlipActorRoute plus MOVE.OBJECTIVE.ACTOR_ROUTE_START and MOVE.OBJECTIVE.ACTOR_ROUTE_DESTINATION own legal landspeed progress accepted by the engine's Filters.toward relation, including a boosted direct Courtyard-to-Throne move.
ActivateActionPolicy plus V168 and V38.3 recognize the objective's exact Activate 1 Force action.
ObjectiveBattlePolicy plus BATTLE.OBJECTIVE.REQUIRED_LOCATION_CONTEST owns a safe contest at the missing Throne Room.
ForceLossPolicy V21-objective and BattleForfeitPolicy BATTLE.OBJECTIVE.FLIP_GATE_FORMATION_HOLD preserve the pre-flip actor.
ObjectiveAnalyzer.wouldDepartureTriggerFlipBack plus MOVE.OBJECTIVE.FLIP_BACK_BLOCKER_HOLD and BATTLE.OBJECTIVE.FLIP_GATE_FORMATION_HOLD preserve the sole post-flip blocker.
Rando and Chosen One adapters call the same shared analyzers and policies.
contradictions: Direct deployment to Hallway or Throne Room is illegal while the front is active. A deploy bonus must stage Amidala at an offered exterior setup-route site, not invent a direct deployment.
V41 wrong-direction logic may otherwise reject movement toward an empty objective site. Only a proven closer actor-route hop receives the exemption.
Formation Safety remains absolute before the parent +600 or destination +1000 route contribution. An objective bonus cannot authorize a solo charge or abandonment.
Generic deploy, drain, and consolidation scores may choose another Naboo location unless the exact actor-route contribution dominates their bounded positive scores.
Post-flip protection must follow the exact opponent-control law. Merely losing Light Side control, or Amidala leaving an uncontested Throne Room, is not a flip-back condition.
